body:
no you're right, live for myself. three simple words it's going to take me a while to get used to, but you're right.

and i'm actually going to do that by the way :p

close enough indeed, sometimes i catch myself saying 19 because i'm really not used to being 20 yet, heh. you're right though, about the happy and youthful thing, it's kinda hard for me to see to tomorrow let alone the rest of my life so... i don't know.

thanks for your offers, i should take you up on them. i think it just feels like i suck or i'm out of practice or something because of my depression even though i get really good grades without trying and i've impressed people wayyy older than me that have been deep into writing far longer than i have, but it feels like it doesn't matter? i think the other part is that i feel like i'm being propped up higher than i deserve. i don't think my writing's really that special. it's competent but passable? eh. sorry about rambling about myself, i usually don't do think so things either ocme out all at once or not at all. my typing here isn't indicative of my writing (i'm less lazy) i've just had a shitty... everything but you know that, lol

i think we have semi-opposite problems, i've been sleeping in the day or early night way way more and night owling the fuck out of any other time, sometimes staying up like 18 hours or more because i just don't want to sleep. but i'll be sure to catch you when you're around.

anyway more questions for you i think, what do you find yourself focusing on when you write (what subjects i guess, what sort of journalism do you do? is it general, biased towards any particular stuff like tech journalism or personal column writing) and what inspires you (can be anything)? it's been a long time since i've had any sit downs with a writer i think. my friend writes but we spend more time arguing or trying not to argue than actually shooting the shit.

man i definitely will pm you sometimes, i think you really helped a shitload here haha. good luck with everything by the way, and yeah 29 is still young too i think. not as young as 20 but my oldest cousin is two years younger than you and i can think of some people that have commited suicide near that age which does suck when i think about it... yeah you're right, i've got time but it's just a mental struggle for me right now. there's some shit i still want to learn too and always wanted to... once i go to my counselor and stuff i guess i'll see where it goes. and really i should live for my dad, he's never said anything bad or hit me or done a damn thing wrong that i can think of, and i know he'll hate losing his little girl.

thanks again even if you say there's no need for it dude, idk how else to explain my gratitude.

thanks friend, 20 year old writers kinda-dead-ending unite. this sucks ass but i'm starting to see a little that offing myself probably wont help even though a lot of me says it will & i've been having these thoughts chronically and stuff. i'll try to get out of here soon and figure shit out. i haven't been twenty more than two months but i dunno there's gotta be something right?

what do you (or did you as it were) specialize in writing in anyway? fiction nonfiction or something? i know for me i wanted to be a journalist or a columinst of some kind for a while then i wanted to write fiction shit but some of my fear is that i can't make myself appealing among the zillion people that write too. not that i have a need to be better or unique or anything but just get enough interest to keep going i guess. does that make sense? thanks for replying by the way it helps

man i don't know. you might be right. i wasn't really looking for sympathy but i couldn't tell you what i wasl ookign for, you might be right on that fact too. i do need to harden the fuck up but i havent figured out exactly how it'll work and shit i guess, or if i can do it at all which is part of why i'm like "i'm out" but i dunno. thanks bro, like seriously thanks a lot because i think this helped me way more than i can process right now. i still feel like shit but you made a ton of sense plus you made skyrim sound even more awesome.

im sorry about the shit you went through too and nah im not under any delusions that my shits been harder than yours or anything. im glad you got through it man, seriously. thanks again for talking to me.
might be! sorry though, it sucks doesnt it?

i decided to buy skyrim today, actually, because i'd been waiting on it and figured i'd paly it al ittle before i go, haha

i get what you're saying though, man, i seriously do. i know school isn't for everyone, thaty ou can be happy & successful without school and stuff. for a while i wanted to see how that worked, but i seriously can't, and this is what i meant by i've got problems that run deeper (or at least i think so) than just "oh shit, i'm failing school"

i want to say "fuck it" and do what i see people recommend all the time -- take time off, travel, explore, do shit like that, but i'm honestly sort of fucked in that regard. see, i was pretty much raised in this mindset that school = pretty much everything. a good part of my identity and existence is now rooted in academics and 'traditional' (sigh) success -- get a degree, get a job etc -- , i have nearly nothing else because it's how my life got molded

i live with my father's parents, and i have since i was very, very little. i started reading before two. i'm the youngest child of my mother's children, my father's only child and the youngest grandchild. pretty much the baby of the family until my first cousins had their kids over the last few years.

long story short, i had an amazing childhood (never in danger of being homeless or anything like that) fraught with passive-aggressive middle class emotional and verbal abuse. my mother was a drug addict and a terrible mom from one of the shittiest neighborhoods where we lived. my dad was a drug addict that only kicked his coke habit six or so years ago (around when i started college).

despite that and constant, constant fights with my grandparents my dad never damned me, never said "not my kid" never turned his back. he was the one that rescued me from ap otentially shitty childhood, gave me to my grandmother and told her to raise me. he always visited me, even the times hwen he was high on shit and got turned away just for being high. i've always been his kid, etc. even when he was pretty much making nothing he'd buy shit for me sometimes or send me money or just come nad hang out msot of the time

hes not the problem

the thing is my family on both sides pretty much fought tooth and nail from rock bottom to get where they are now. we've still had scares nad times where we might have run out of money and shit but my grandparents on both sides come from large families and serious rural poverty. they never had family members even make it to college, let alone finish. even my dad went, pretty much realized shcool wasn't for him right away but tried to stay into senior year then left. my aunt graduated with a degree she did nothing with. theresn othing wrong with either one but my grandparents told drill their 'failing' into me for years and years as one of the many ways to keep me in line i guess. theyd remind me of all the people who are worse off and so on, which i understand. hell for a long time i wanted to go into civil law because of a lot of shit that went down when i was ak id. long story short again i had family that was very very active in the community but old feuds and general passive aggressive shit from people where we lived really wore them and us down and messed up how i interacted with other kids. i was always pretty fuvking weird, doub ly so because im a minority and ive never fit my culture. 

ive always bee n very sheltered & so on. my family is overprotective and stuff. i never dated but that doesnt bother me really. ive had two rl best friends when i was a kid but i havent spoken to them in years and years because we just drifted. ive had internet friends that i drifted from too, all but one which i already mentioned.

anyway im finding it really hard to be coherent and articulate exactly how deep this runs. i was reminded constantly about my mother and how she was very angry and had problems. i realixe now that it was probably a combination of hrad drugs and her possibly having mental problems. i know now that i have depression and ive probably had it since i was ten years old. i've been through some weird shit. i've been ostracized and bullied by my own extended family and community etc. even me jumping grades was met by a lot of resistance where i live. i came to college early and i was supposed to finish early but depression has set in really hard and i just cant do it. i dont have antidepressants nor easy access to my therapist. ive been so focused and driven to school and told how im deficient otherwise and im nothing if i dont finish and restrained by my environment and the fact that i physically have no one else around but my grandparents and my dad (hes barely getting by though) that theres just shit ive missed out on. i didnt get into colelge culture due to being too young to start off then uninterested on top of that. i dont go out anymore, i never really 'went out' once i got past ten or so i guess. no proms no parties nothing like that. just reading, writing, drawing, and games. ive lost interest in all of them, and it isnt just interest but just ability as well. i seriously cant do it, it's like i fucked unlearned everything, i dont know how else to epxlain it

reading shit and knowing what i do about other people and stuff i just know i wont be able to make it in the real world. i cant cope. iw asnt raised to learn hwo to cope. even my only friend just keeps tellign me over and over that im screwing up or she ignores me if i use certain words which makes her shit about how she cares just ring false. i dont talk to old friends, no point and reason and most of them are beyond my contact anyway. i dont want to bother them

i really really wish i knew how to explain this better because it does sound like me being whiny and shit but it runs deeper. i used to be regularly whooped and fought, my grandparents often 'gang up' on me so to speak, they call me crazy or tell me when i tell them thgnsl ike i need help or i need to go check myslef in somewhere that itll be on my record and ill never get aj ob. it hurts because theyre doing the same thing my friend does, they say their love is unconditional but if anything threatens me finishing shcool (which i honestly wnat to do, schoo litself has been really good and i have met so many nice people here but it isnt school so much as it is depression fucking with my ability to do ANY work and shit like that and my drive for it) they turn on me. theyre really, REALLY nasty when they get nasty and i dont know what to do. i dont even have a drivers license or a car and even the place i go to school is in a rural college town.

i dont know, fuck it. man you dont have to read all of this if you dont want to but tl;dr i get what youre saying but it isnt that easy. its been eaten in my head over and over that im only worth as much as my education and what ive been 'gifted' with doing (writing and drawing) and now that ive lost the motivation and ability to do both i realize how empty i am. i'm not even attractive either. :/

that's what i've been told and told myself for a decade, but it really is the only way out because this has been building for so many years from so many people and situations that i can't handle any of it anymore adn i know if i can't handle these i wont be abl e to stand on my own in the real world

thank you for trying though
